statement.essentials: The “lobes” of the parotid are not separate parts: surgeons call the tissue on the outer side of the nerve “superficial” and the rest “deep”.
statement.anatomy: The superficial and deep lobes are a surgical division defined by the plane of the facial nerve; by weight about two-thirds of the gland lies superficial to it, and most tumours arise there.
statement.clinical: In 19 specimens the lateral levels I and II together held 61–69% of the weight (ESGS levels, the ranges for levels I and II summed).

numbers.label: Gland weight lateral to the nerve plane (levels I + II, reported ranges summed)
numbers.design: Anatomical dissection study (sum of two reported ranges)

limitations: A sum of ranges the paper reports for each level, not a figure it states; the model’s superficial share (59%) is reported against it, not tuned to it.
